description: Default permissions for the main window. File system access does NOT go through the fs plugin but through our own commands in ul-core, which enforce a sandbox rooted at the workspace. The window permissions are the ones the frame in the interface needs: the window has no system title bar, so minimising, maximising, closing and dragging are ours to do. The updater and the restart that follows it are in `desktop.json`, because those plugins do not exist in the Android build and a permission naming a plugin that was never compiled fails the build script rather than being ignored.
